assets.title: 金面罩与大型铜器线索
assets.prompt: Photorealistic museum catalog image for Sanxingdui K3, ancient bronze zun and bronze lei ritual vessel group with a small gold mask fragment, realistic archaeological artifact photography, dark museum background, oxidized bronze patina, hammered gold surface, no text.

assets.title: 铜扭头跪坐人像线索
assets.prompt: Photorealistic museum catalog image for Sanxingdui K4, ancient bronze kneeling human figure with twisted turned head and ritual posture, green-blue oxidized bronze patina, neutral museum background, no text.

assets.title: 木箱、玉刀与小型遗存
assets.prompt: Photorealistic museum catalog image for Sanxingdui K6, weathered wooden box remnant, pale jade blade or jade knife, cinnabar-red powder traces and textile residue fragments, realistic archaeological display, no text.

assets.title: 龟背形网格状铜器与玉石器
assets.prompt: Photorealistic museum catalog image for Sanxingdui K7, tortoise-shell-shaped openwork bronze grid object with jade pieces, curved turtle-back lattice made of aged bronze ribs, realistic archaeological artifact photography, no text.

assets.title: 顶尊蛇身人像与神话性铜器组合
assets.prompt: Photorealistic museum catalog image for Sanxingdui K8, complex ancient bronze ritual assemblage with zun-shaped vessel top, sinuous snake-like human or animal motif and bronze altar elements, realistic oxidized bronze museum photography, no text.
